topics.title: Stern’s LA Launch – Initial Technical Issues
topics.summary: Howard Stern begins his Los Angeles broadcast with immediate technical difficulties. A malfunctioning fan and equipment problems delay phone lines, causing frustration as he addresses perceived criticism from New York and anticipates negative reactions in Los Angeles. The segment concludes with an introduction to new co-hosts and a promise of taking calls.

topics.title: Oakland A’s Radio Coverage & Legal Investigation
topics.summary: An FBI investigation reveals that Thomas Hagan wired $200,000 to his mother after leaving Oakland. The radio broadcast includes around-the-league sports scores and discussions about Dave Henderson's hitting slump while also featuring a segment on Howard Stern discussing an encounter with Tom regarding repeated questioning of the time.

topics.title: Dial-a-Date & Los Angeles Fury
topics.summary: During the broadcast, hosts Gary Bryan and Robin discuss their frustration with TV producers in Los Angeles copying their ‘dial-a-date’ routine while fantasizing about sexually humiliating them. They detail absurd stunts they won't do – like bungee jumping or jello jumps – and propose a listener contest involving sex with a chosen LA resident if they win an NBC show competition.”} 29 words”**

topics.title: Oakland Athletics Dominant Performance
topics.summary: The Oakland A’s had a strong night at the plate, combining for ten hits and eight runs including two home runs with seven RBIs against the Indians. Elsewhere in baseball, the New York Yankees defeated Seattle 10-2 while Mark Hall recorded four hits and four RBI's and Mattingly added three hits and scored twice.

topics.title: Stern’s Surprise Weight Loss Film Project
topics.summary: Howard Stern plans to fly across the country visiting people who have lost weight with a film crew led by pilot Ed Shipley. He intends to surprise them, videotape their journeys for his new show ‘Surprises Across America,’ and acknowledges recent celebrity deaths like Michael Landon while discussing potential targets such as Rick Deese.

topics.title: Stern Confronts Simmons Over Reynolds’ Funeral Drawings
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses a phone call where he confronted Burt Reynolds about not attending his funeral and the drawings Reynolds made for him. He expresses frustration over perceived insincerity, explores the context of the drawings as gifts from celebrities, and engages in tangential conversations regarding Richard Simmons's reactions to Sam Kennison’s HBO special.

topics.title: Rolling Stone Interview & ABC Radio
topics.summary: During a two-hour Rolling Stone interview, subject repeatedly clashed with the photographer over time constraints and perceived obsequiousness, making jokes to an ABC reporter about the article’s quality while questioning the interviewer's questions. The conversation included awkward exchanges and humorous remarks regarding the journalist’s inquiries.
